Dispatch.premises: distinct local names for simp/compact_arith only

Split.name: fresh intro name or null; local cases name; null otherwise

Use.compile: [use name if imported]; [specialize name term]*; apply name
Use.name: local hypothesis, PA1..PA6, or finite allowed checked theorem
Use.specializations: bounded term array; PA constants require empty array

json_value_types.bounds: exact object with integer max_calls=1 (not Boolean)
json_value_types.name_variable_source_direction_location_: strings, except Split.name may be null

actions.transaction: one generated semicolon sequence through run_surface; failed state/history unchanged

authority.catalog_identity: separate caller-owned epoch; not frozen by this syntax profile
authority.commands_and_imports: finite caller-owned SurfaceCapabilities, bound in each receipt
authority.import_check: public use independently checks the imported certificate

axioms.formula: ∀ x. ∀ y. S x = S y → x = y
axioms.name: PA2

axioms.formula: ∀ x. ∀ y. x + S y = S (x + y)
axioms.name: PA4

axioms.formula: ∀ x. ∀ y. x · S y = x · y + x
axioms.name: PA6

profile.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no nonfinite values

evidence.h0_remaining: independent semantic/reference conformance, cold replay and protocol gate reviews
evidence.positive: independent native kernel replay against the original closed goal
evidence.proposal_receipt: provenance only, never an execution or QED certificate

grammar.alpha_equivalence: native AST equality; canonical fresh binder pretty-printing
grammar.binders: de Bruijn, nearest binder index 0; context index-to-name order
grammar.statements: closed formulas only; no implicit universal closure

surface_sugar.le: a <= b becomes exists k. k + a = b (capture-avoiding)

induction.context: native dependent-context generalization and eigenvariable checks
induction.formula_restriction: profile grammar and resource ceilings; not a decision fragment

limits.scope: statement/action admission; derived states retain source-bound native proof ceilings

native_dispatch_limits.refl_assumption: one public primitive under live-certificate ceilings
